p051_honest_negatives_DO_NOT_REMOVE.count: Eleven, bringing the portfolio to at least twenty-seven.
p051_honest_negatives_DO_NOT_REMOVE.headline: The learned switch predictor LOSES to the exact analytic switching condition on that condition's own criterion, on BOTH axes: F1 0.980685 against 1.000000 (18 false positives, 13 false negatives in 9600 steps) and 846x the per-decision latency (7343.16 us against 8.68 us). No forest size closes it - a 20-tree forest is still 198x at F1 0.978301 - because the latency is sklearn per-call overhead and the accuracy error is an axis-aligned staircase against fifty non-axis-aligned halfspaces. No retune was attempted.
p051_honest_negatives_DO_NOT_REMOVE.lead5_win_reported_as_different_question: The learned model DOES win the lead-5 anticipation task, F1 0.896 against 0.587 for the best exact predictor, and this is published as a different question rather than a better answer, because the exact predictor answers 'may fire' and over-predicts by construction (precision 0.435 at recall 0.863). It still costs about 500x more per decision.
p051_honest_negatives_DO_NOT_REMOVE.no_margin: A 10 percent underestimate of the declared disturbance bound already produces violations; first violation at rho = 1.10 under the worst-case vertex sampler. STRUCTURAL: the recursion computes the MAXIMAL robust invariant set, so invariance holds with equality and the facet-wise slack of S inside X is exactly [0,0,0,0].
p051_honest_negatives_DO_NOT_REMOVE.chatter: 64.8 percent of performance intervals and 31.4 percent of baseline intervals last ONE step. A minimum baseline dwell of 2 reduces the switch rate NOT AT ALL while raising the authority fraction 0.084 to 0.096 and the cost ratio 1.198341 to 1.201536. A validation check asserting a STRICTLY decreasing switch rate was weakened to non-increasing when this was measured, and the plateau is reported rather than hidden.
p051_honest_negatives_DO_NOT_REMOVE.unsound_lead_predictor: The exact worst-case lead predictor is NOT sound on realised episodes - recall 0.862841, missing 13.7 percent of firings - because it ignores performance-input saturation (9.3729 percent of steps) and the guard's own intervention inside the horizon.
p051_honest_negatives_DO_NOT_REMOVE.coverage: S covers only 85.507589 percent of X: 14.5 percent of states satisfying every declared constraint are outside the certificate. At 12x the declared bound the guard eliminates only 19.79 percent of the unguarded violations, against 100 percent at 1x. Below a reference amplitude of 0.12 rad the guard never fires and is pure overhead, cost ratio exactly 1.000000.
p051_honest_negatives_DO_NOT_REMOVE.agent_own_error_recorded: The agent's first 1-D known-answer test was written against the MINIMAL RPI set wmax/(1-|lambda|) (Rakovic et al. 2005) when the switching condition needs the MAXIMAL set. Found, corrected with the arithmetic shown in full, and recorded in VALIDATION.md section 7 item 9 rather than quietly fixed.

tool_defects_found_PROPAGATE.sklearn_prefit_removed: CalibratedClassifierCV(base, cv='prefit') raises InvalidParameterError on scikit-learn 1.9.1; 'prefit' was removed in favour of sklearn.frozen.FrozenEstimator. Any Batch 06 product calibrating a prefit classifier must use FrozenEstimator.
tool_defects_found_PROPAGATE.sklearn_njobs_inference: RandomForestClassifier with n_jobs>1 is 5.7x SLOWER at single-row inference than n_jobs=1 (33.1 ms against 5.8 ms for 150 trees) because of joblib dispatch overhead. Set n_jobs=1 after fitting before benchmarking per-call latency, or the learned model is benchmarked at its worst.
